name: Demon Flesh
body:
School abjuration [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser demon flesh, but grants the subject damage reduction 10/cold iron and good for the duration of the spell.

Demon Flesh, Lesser

School abjuration [evil]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of flesh from a demon)/DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The creature touched gains damage reduction 5/cold iron and good for the duration of the spell. Once the spell prevents a total of 10 points of damage per caster level (maximum 100 points), it is discharged.
